author: Unity
description:
This is the third video in our series on Unity Industry Cloud, a collaborative 3D platform designed for teams to create, review, and deliver immersive experiences. This video shows you how to build your first automated pipeline, so that every time a new CAD file is uploaded to a project, it automatically converts, optimizes, and prepares 3D assets to the standards required by that project without any manual intervention. 

Topics covered in this video:
✅ Create, test, and monitor a pipeline
✅ Configure the automation trigger
✅ Define filters
✅ Map parameters
✅ Organize folders

Unity Asset Manager is available with both the Unity Industry and Unity Studio subscriptions. Unity Studio is a no-code, web-based editor that empowers anyone within an organization to create and share in 3D. Unity Industry includes the Unity Editor and provides advanced visualization, simulation, AR/VR, and interactive applications to accelerate innovation and improve workflows.
